title: Align DataExtractor and TaxReport mapping
description: Wire canonical income resolution into DataExtractorService and TaxReportService so Exgratia values visible in Daftar Upah also enter Pajak, while fields like pendapatan_bonus, taxable_pendapatan_bonus, bonus_amount, and exgratia_amount derive from a single source amount.
convergence: Monthly tax rows and Daftar Upah rows carry matching other-income totals and aliases.
